result_record.operation: Exact-tag Apache Kafka 4.2.0 cross-check of MessageDataGenerator flexible variable-length encoding against ListTransactionsResponse arrays.
result_record.finding: Kafka 4.2.0 MessageDataGenerator reads flexible variable-length fields with unsigned-varint length minus one and writes them with unsigned-varint length plus one. ListTransactionsResponse is flexible for all supported versions 0-2, and UnknownStateFilters plus TransactionStates are arrays present in all those versions, so their array-length prefixes use that compact rule; empty arrays therefore map to prefix 1 under this generator path. This closes the prior generator-mapping source gap but is not itself evidence of a serializer bug or runtime failure.
result_record.scope_guard: Only Kafka tag 4.2.0 MessageDataGenerator.java plus ListTransactionsResponse.json, specifically the two top-level ListTransactionsResponse array-length prefixes in versions 0-2. No generalization to other tags, non-generated serializers, tagged-field sizing, or runtime behavior.
